systems.system: National civil registration database and digital registration system (Law No. 46, 2026)
systems.owner: Agaasinka Adeegyada Dad-dhigista iyo Tirakoobka Xaaladaha Madaniga ah (Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Directorate)
systems.tiers: federal, federal member state, Banadir, district

note: Law No. 46 (Official Bulletin 5 April 2026) is a civil registration law for one sector; Art. 10 and 11(2)(f) say its digital system can share data with institutions the law allows, and Art. 38(5) bars sharing with anyone the law does not permit; no general public-body data sharing duty, so class other.
